== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Wakey wakey. Lorne Kates of Ontario, Canada overslept the day of his Star Trek CCG World Finals." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
